title: Topic 1.1: Origin and Consequences of Sin

pages.lesson:
LESSON: ORIGIN AND CONSEQUENCES OF SIN

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: CREATION
Topic 1.1: Origin and Consequences of Sin

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Origin and Consequences of Sin. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why is it important to consider the consequences of something before acting?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Origin and Consequences of Sin using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Origin and Consequences of Sin in the examples.
2. Explain Origin and Consequences of Sin to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Origin and Consequences of Sin.
4. Show that you can: explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Origin and Consequences of Sin using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Origin and Consequences of Sin important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read Genesis 3:1-13 and write short notes on the origin of sin,
2. Read Genesis 3: 14-19, 23, 4:6-12, Genesis 11:1-9 and make notes on the consequences of sin,
3. List the sins young people are likely to commit today,
4. Discuss the causes of sin among young people today,
5. Write the moral values and life skills on charts and display them in class,

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the origin of sin from the scriptures provided

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
